settings.qf: original Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B @ pinned revision, query-first prompts, BF16 KV, prefix caching on
settings.df: merged doc-first LoRA (artifacts/lora/df/merged, sha256 checked), variant B doc-first prompts, BF16 KV, prefix caching on
settings.df_fp8: same as df with --kv-cache-dtype fp8 (vLLM native; record its scale handling, do not equate with our per-head scales)
settings.shared: identical server flags otherwise (max_model_len 512, gpu_memory_utilization 0.90, seed = cfg.seed); token-id prompts only; max_tokens 1; temperature 0; allowed_token_ids [no, yes]; score = logprob(yes) - logprob(no); vLLM version pinned in requirements-vllm.txt

rules.G1_yes_no_path: blocking: every gate request returns logprobs for both yes (9693) and no (2152); pass = 100% of requests
rules.G2_score_agreement: diagnostic, not blocking: per order on the 256-pair subset, mean |vLLM bf16 - HF fp32| vs mean |HF MPS bf16 - HF fp32| (full prompt); report ratio, max, pair flip rate, tie count; flag if ratio > 2.0 (vLLM computes yes/no logits in bf16, ours in fp32)
rules.G3_prefix_cache: blocking: on doc-first probes (same doc, two different queries, prefix cache reset before each probe), the second request's reported cached tokens >= floor(cache_len / 16) * 16 (block-aligned doc prefix) on every probe; first request after reset reports 0. Exact agreement with the 8a.1 simulator rule is recorded separately (validates the simulation, not the gate)
rules.G4_quality: blocking for df: vLLM df (BF16 KV) trace 3, first cold run, nDCG@10 within 0.01 of HF doc-first LoRA full prompt (|delta| <= 0.01) on both datasets; same check reported for qf vs the original model (qf failing marks qf quality only; its systems numbers are still reported). Paired CI and W/L/T reported
rules.fp8_vs_bf16_in_vllm: reported: df_fp8 vs df on the same trace 3 pairs, paired.compare + paired.verdict with the 5.2 margins (results/metrics/quant_noise_floor.json)

measurement.cold: prefix cache reset immediately before the trace
measurement.warm: the same trace rerun immediately after the cold run, no reset
measurement.latency: client-side end to end per request (send to response), p50 / p95
measurement.throughput: requests/s and prompt tokens/s over the trace's wall time
measurement.hit_tokens: per request usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens; doc-token reuse = cached tokens inside each request's doc span / doc tokens (same definition as the 8a.1 simulation)
measurement.recorded: physical block size, num_gpu_blocks, prefix-match granularity, attention backend, kv cache dtype, fp8 scale handling

rules.claims: only measured numbers go in results and README; trace 3 reported as measured, including little benefit; no vLLM throughput claims for INT4 or pruned caches
pod_cut_order: gate (G1, G3 on smoke; G2 subset) <= 60 min
trace 3, c=16, cold + warm, settings df, qf, df_fp8 (G4 from the first df run)
trace 3, c=1 and c=4, cold + warm
traces 1 and 2, all settings, c=16 then c=1, 4
rules.fallback: if G1, G3 or df G4 is not passing by 12:00 CT Fri Nov 27, or no pod is available, apply with the Phase 5 resume; apply by 18:00 CT regardless
